name: Turn customer reviews into ready to publish content

nodes.name: Review submission form
nodes.notes:
User pastes any customer review, testimonial, or case study outcome.

The form works for:
- Google reviews
- LinkedIn recommendations
- Email testimonials
- Video testimonial transcripts
- Case study outcome summaries

The AI handles any format and any length.

parameters.formDescription: Paste a customer review or testimonial and receive 7 platform-ready content pieces in your email within 2 minutes.

nodes.name: Set config
nodes.notes:
REPLACE THESE 4 VALUES ONLY:

1. recipientEmail
   Who receives the content package email
   Example: you@example.com

2. senderName
   Your name for email sign-offs
   Example: Rahul Dutt

3. sheetId
   Open your Google Sheet in browser
   URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ABC123/edit
   Copy the part between /d/ and /edit
   Create a tab called: Review Content Log
   Row 1 headers:
   Date | Customer Name | Business Type | Review Snippet | Opportunity Score | Emotional Tone | Best Quote | LinkedIn Story | Twitter Post | Website Testimonial | Submitted By | Logged At

4. senderName (same as above)

All form fields are mapped automatically.
Do not change any expression fields.

nodes.name: Analyse the review
nodes.notes:
First AI agent — deeply analyzes the review before any content is written.

Outputs 8 fields:
1. businessType — who the reviewer is
2. coreTransformation — before vs after
3. specificBenefit — most concrete result
4. emotionalTone — single word emotion
5. bestQuotablePhrase — exact pull quote from review
6. credibilitySignals — what makes it trustworthy
7. impliedPainSolved — what problem they had
8. contentOpportunityScore — 1-10 shareability rating

Separating analysis from content generation (two-agent approach)
gives significantly better output quality.

Output is in $json.output

parameters.text:
=You are a senior content strategist who specializes in extracting maximum value from customer testimonials.

A customer has left a review for {{ $json.businessName }}, a {{ $json.businessType }}.

Reviewer: {{ $json.reviewerName }}
Reviewer profile: {{ $json.reviewerCompany }}

Review text:
{{ $json.reviewText }}

Analyze this review deeply and return ONLY a valid JSON object. No extra text. No markdown. No backticks.

Required fields:

businessType
One sentence describing what type of business or role the reviewer represents. Under 15 words.

coreTransformation
The main before-and-after change this review describes. What was their situation before vs after working with {{ $json.businessName }}? Under 20 words.

specificBenefit
The single most concrete, measurable, or specific result mentioned. Under 15 words. If no specific result mentioned, write: General satisfaction expressed without specific metrics.

emotionalTone
Exactly one word that best captures the emotion in this review: Delighted, Relieved, Impressed, Grateful, Surprised, Confident, or Satisfied.

bestQuotablePhrase
The 5 to 10 most powerful consecutive words from the review that could stand alone as a pull quote. Copy them exactly from the review.

credibilitySignals
Array of 2 to 4 strings. Elements in this review that make it credible and shareable — specific details, numbers, timeframes, named results, or professional context. Empty array if none found.

impliedPainSolved
One sentence. What problem or frustration was the reviewer experiencing before they found {{ $json.businessName }}? Infer from context. Under 20 words.

contentOpportunityScore
Number from 1 to 10 showing how shareable and valuable this review is for content.
1 to 4: generic praise, no specifics, low credibility.
5 to 6: decent but lacks unique detail.
7 to 8: specific, credible, good story potential.
9 to 10: outstanding — specific results, emotional, highly credible, excellent story.

nodes.name: Keep the analysis
nodes.notes:
Saves analysis output from Agent 1 and carries all form data forward.
Sets isHighValue = true when score is 7 or above.
This flag controls the IF routing node later.
No changes needed.

nodes.name: Worth turning into content?
nodes.notes:
TRUE — score is 7 or above — generate full 7-piece content package
FALSE — score below 7 — log and send brief note only

The threshold of 7 can be changed here.
A score below 7 usually means the review is too vague
or generic to generate compelling content from.

No changes needed.

nodes.name: Write the content pack
nodes.notes:
Second AI agent — generates 7 content pieces from the analyzed review.

Outputs:
1. linkedinStory — 300 word narrative with quote and hashtags
2. linkedinShort — 100 word punchy version
3. twitterPost — under 250 chars
4. websiteTestimonial — polished 60 word version
5. emailNewsletterFeature — 120 word newsletter intro
6. reviewerThankYouEmail — personalized thank you
7. caseStudyInviteEmail — professional invite for deeper collaboration

The agent uses the structured analysis from Agent 1
so every piece references the specific benefit and credibility signals.

Output is in $json.output

parameters.text:
=You are a world-class content marketing specialist who turns customer testimonials into compelling multi-platform content.

Business: {{ $json.businessName }} ({{ $json.businessType_cfg }})
Reviewer: {{ $json.reviewerName }} — {{ $json.reviewerCompany }}

Original review:
{{ $json.reviewText }}

Review intelligence extracted:
Core transformation: {{ $json.coreTransformation }}
Specific benefit: {{ $json.specificBenefit }}
Best quotable phrase: "{{ $json.bestQuotablePhrase }}"
Emotional tone: {{ $json.emotionalTone }}
Pain solved: {{ $json.impliedPainSolved }}
Credibility signals: {{ $json.credibilitySignals.join(', ') }}

Generate a complete content package. Return ONLY a valid JSON object. No extra text. No markdown. No backticks.

Required fields:

linkedinStory
280 to 350 words. First-person narrative storytelling format. Open with a specific scenario or moment (not a generic opener). Build to the outcome. Quote the review directly at the peak moment. Close with a question for engagement. Plain text — do not use emoji, bullet points, or hashtags inside the story. End with 3 to 5 relevant hashtags on a new line.

linkedinShort
80 to 120 words. Punchy, one big insight from the review. Opens with a bold statement. References {{ $json.reviewerName }} by first name. Ends with a call to action. Add 3 hashtags at the end.

twitterPost
Under 250 characters. One sentence insight or result. Short and shareable. Ends with 2 hashtags.

websiteTestimonial
40 to 70 words. Polished, third-person friendly version of the review for a testimonial page. Preserves the emotion but tightens the language. Attributes to {{ $json.reviewerName }}, {{ $json.reviewerCompany }}.

emailNewsletterFeature
90 to 130 words. Warm intro paragraph for a newsletter that features this client win. Written as if updating subscribers on a recent success story. Ends with a soft CTA.

reviewerThankYouEmail
80 to 100 words. Personalized email to {{ $json.reviewerName }} thanking them specifically for this review. References something specific they said. Warm, genuine, not salesy. Signs off from {{ $json.senderName }} at {{ $json.businessName }}.

caseStudyInviteEmail
100 to 120 words. Professional email to {{ $json.reviewerName }} inviting them to participate in a full case study. Explains the mutual benefit. References their result specifically. Not pushy. Signs off from {{ $json.senderName }} at {{ $json.businessName }}.

nodes.name: Assemble the pack
nodes.notes:
Combines all 7 content pieces and review intelligence into one email.

Email has 8 sections:
1. Summary (score, reviewer, core transformation, pull quote)
2. Original review
3. LinkedIn Story (300 words, ready to post)
4. LinkedIn Short Post (100 words, for re-sharing)
5. Twitter/X Post (under 250 chars)
6. Website Testimonial (60 words, polished)
7. Email Newsletter Feature (120 words)
8. Reviewer Thank You Email
9. Case Study Invitation Email

Subject line highlights exceptional reviews (score 9+) separately.
Also prepares clean Sheets logging fields.
No changes needed.

parameters.jsCode:
const content = $input.first().json.output;
const analysis = $('Keep the analysis').item.json;

if (!content) {
  throw new Error('Content generation failed. Check your OpenAI credential.');
}

const score = analysis.contentOpportunityScore;
const scoreLabel = score >= 9 ? 'Exceptional' : score >= 7 ? 'High Value' : 'Standard';
const credSignals = (analysis.credibilitySignals || []).join(', ') || 'None identified';

// Build full email body
const emailBody =
  'Hello ' + analysis.senderName + ',\n\n' +
  'Your 7-piece content package is ready for this review from ' + analysis.reviewerName + '.\n\n' +
  'Content Opportunity Score: ' + score + ' out of 10 — ' + scoreLabel + '\n' +
  'Reviewer: ' + analysis.reviewerName + ' — ' + analysis.reviewerCompany + '\n' +
  'Emotional tone: ' + analysis.emotionalTone + '\n' +
  'Core transformation: ' + analysis.coreTransformation + '\n' +
  'Best pull quote: "' + analysis.bestQuotablePhrase + '"\n' +
  'Credibility signals: ' + credSignals + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'ORIGINAL REVIEW\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  analysis.reviewText + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'LINKEDIN STORY (300 words — paste and publish)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.linkedinStory + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'LINKEDIN SHORT POST (100 words — for re-sharing)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.linkedinShort + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'TWITTER / X POST (paste and tweet)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.twitterPost + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'WEBSITE TESTIMONIAL (add to testimonials page)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.websiteTestimonial + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'EMAIL NEWSLETTER FEATURE (paste into your next newsletter)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.emailNewsletterFeature + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'REVIEWER THANK YOU EMAIL (send to ' + analysis.reviewerName + ')\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.reviewerThankYouEmail + '\n\n' +

  '============================================================\n' +
  'CASE STUDY INVITATION EMAIL (send when ready to go deeper)\n' +
  '============================================================\n\n' +
  content.caseStudyInviteEmail + '\n\n' +

  'All review content is logged in your Google Sheets Review Content Log tab.\n\n' +
  'Best regards,\n' + analysis.senderName;

const loggedAt = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16);

return [{
  json: {
    emailSubject: score >= 9
      ? 'Exceptional Review Content Package — ' + analysis.reviewerName + ' — ' + analysis.today
      : 'Content Package Ready — ' + analysis.reviewerName + ' — ' + analysis.today,
    emailBody,
    recipientEmail: analysis.recipientEmail,
    // Sheets fields
    today: analysis.today,
    reviewerName: analysis.reviewerName,
    businessType: analysis.businessType,
    reviewSnippet: analysis.reviewText.substring(0, 150) + '...',
    opportunityScore: score + ' out of 10 — ' + scoreLabel,
    emotionalTone: analysis.emotionalTone,
    bestQuote: analysis.bestQuotablePhrase,
    linkedinStory: content.linkedinStory.substring(0, 300),
    twitterPost: content.twitterPost,
    websiteTestimonial: content.websiteTestimonial,
    submittedBy: analysis.submittedBy,
    loggedAt,
    sheetId: analysis.sheetId,
    sheetName: analysis.sheetName
  }
}];

1. Go to console.cloud.google.com and enable the Gmail API
2. In n8n: Settings → Credentials → Add New → Gmail OAuth2
3. Authenticate and connect to this node

You receive 7 ready-to-use pieces:
- LinkedIn Story and Short Post (copy and schedule)
- Twitter post (copy and tweet)
- Website testimonial (paste on your testimonials page)

nodes.name: Build the short note
nodes.notes:
FALSE branch — review scored below 7.
Still logs the review to Sheets for reference.
Sends a brief email explaining why content was not generated

const analysis = $('Keep the analysis').item.json;

const score = analysis.contentOpportunityScore || 0;
const loggedAt = new Date().toISOString().replace('T', ' ').substring(0, 16);

const briefEmailBody =
  'Hello ' + analysis.senderName + ',\n\n' +
  'A review was submitted but scored below the content generation threshold.\n\n' +
  'Reviewer: ' + analysis.reviewerName + ' — ' + analysis.reviewerCompany + '\n' +
  'Score: ' + score + ' out of 10 (threshold is 7)\n' +
  'Reason: ' + (score < 5
    ? 'Review is too generic to generate compelling content.'
    : 'Review has some value but lacks specific results or credibility signals.') + '\n\n' +
  'Review text:\n' + analysis.reviewText + '\n\n' +
  'The review has been logged to your Google Sheets for reference.\n' +
  'Tip: Ask the reviewer if they can add a specific result or timeframe — that could push it above the threshold.\n\n' +
  'Best regards,\n' + analysis.senderName;

return [{
  json: {
    emailSubject: 'Review Logged — Below Content Threshold — ' + analysis.reviewerName + ' — ' + analysis.today,
    emailBody: briefEmailBody,
    recipientEmail: analysis.recipientEmail,
    // Sheets fields
    today: analysis.today,
    reviewerName: analysis.reviewerName,
    businessType: analysis.businessType,
    reviewSnippet: analysis.reviewText.substring(0, 150) + '...',
    opportunityScore: score + ' out of 10 — Below Threshold',
    emotionalTone: analysis.emotionalTone,
    bestQuote: analysis.bestQuotablePhrase || 'N/A',
    linkedinStory: 'Not generated — below threshold',
    twitterPost: 'Not generated — below threshold',
    websiteTestimonial: 'Not generated — below threshold',
    submittedBy: analysis.submittedBy,
    loggedAt,
    sheetId: analysis.sheetId,
    sheetName: analysis.sheetName
  }
}];

parameters.content:
## 1. Read the review
A form collects the review, the customer and the product. GPT scores it for sentiment, specificity and how quotable it is, then decides whether it is worth building content from.

## 2. Strong review: build the pack
A second agent turns it into a testimonial graphic caption, social posts, a case study angle and website copy. The pack is logged, then emailed to you.

## 3. Weak review: just log it
Short or vague reviews skip content generation. They are still recorded in the sheet and you get a one line note.

# Turn customer reviews into ready to publish content

Most good reviews are read once and forgotten. Paste one into a form and this scores it, and when it is strong enough it writes the whole content pack for you: a testimonial graphic caption, social posts, a case study angle and website copy. Weak reviews are logged quietly instead of wasting your time.

### How it works
1. A form collects the review text, the customer name, their role or company, and the product or service.
2. The first agent analyses the review: sentiment, which specific benefits are named, how quotable it is, and an overall content value score.
3. A branch checks that score. Anything below the bar goes down the quiet path.
4. For a strong review, a second agent writes the content pack: a graphic caption, a LinkedIn post, a short social post, a case study angle and a line of website copy.
5. The pack is assembled, appended to your sheet, then emailed to you ready to publish.
6. For a weak review, no content is generated. It is still logged and you get a one line note explaining why it was skipped.

### Setup
1. Add your OpenAI API key and connect your Google Sheets and Gmail accounts.
2. Open Set config and replace your email, your name and your sheet ID.
3. Create a tab called Review Content Log with headers for Date, Customer, Product, Sentiment, Content Score, Quotable Line, Caption, LinkedIn Post, Social Post, Case Study Angle and Website Copy.
4. Activate and share the form URL with your team, or embed it on a thank you page.

### Customization
Lower the score threshold to generate content from more reviews, or edit the second prompt to add the formats you actually publish.
